question: Which of the following grains contain oryzenin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rice**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Oryzenin**, a storage protein present in rice grains, constitutes the** primary glutelin** found in **rice**, comprising approximately 75–90% of the **total protein content in rice grains.**
 
• **Extracting oryzenin** from rice grains and rice flour involves the process of sonification.
 
• Renowned for its high quality, oryzenin boasts a complete amino acid profile.
 
• Widely utilized across various food and beverage sectors, including sports nutrition, meat substitutes, bakery, and confectionery, oryzenin serves as a versatile ingredient.
 
• It emerges as an appealing option for individuals seeking lactose-free and non-allergenic protein sources.
 
• Moreover, it is favoured by those susceptible to gluten sensitivity, as it does not induce digestive complications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Rice**, a cereal grain, serves as the primary dietary staple for more than half of the global population, especially prevalent in Asia and Africa.
 
• It originates from the seeds of two grass species: Oryza sativa (Asian rice) and, less frequently, O. glaberrima (African rice).
 
• Asian rice was cultivated in China approximately 13,500 to 8,200 years ago, while African rice saw domestication in Africa around 3,000 years ago. Rice has gained widespread acceptance across diverse cultures worldwide.
 
• In 2021, global rice production reached 787 million tons, ranking it fourth among agricultural crops, following sugarcane, maize, and wheat.
